value.signature: fn poll_write (self : Pin < & mut Self > , cx : & mut Context < '_ > , buf : & [u8]) -> Poll < io :: Result < usize > >

exception.justification: Justified: Connection plumbing inside the instrumented RPC read; the request byte bound is accounted here without observing request bytes.

review.body: { let this = self . get_mut () ; let mut watch = this . watch . borrow_mut () ; if watch . written + buf . len () > watch . limits . request_bytes { watch . refusal = Some (RpcRefusal :: RequestBytes) ; return Poll :: Ready (Err (refused ())) ; } let count = ready ! (Pin :: new (& mut this . stream) . poll_write (cx , buf)) ? ; watch . written += count ; Poll :: Ready (Ok (count)) }
review.item_premise: This body passes hyper's serialized request, including the sensitive Basic field under its caveat, to the owned socket and counts bytes against the request ceiling; it neither formats nor retains the bytes, and its only state is the public count.
